run_average_models: run the average_models function to average multiple Llama model checkpoints with GPU acceleration and save the result
run_load_model_to_gpu: run the load_model_to_gpu function to load a LlamaForCausalLM model directly onto a GPU with fp16 precision
run_average_weights_gpu: run the average_weights_gpu function to compute a weighted average of multiple model state dicts on GPU
run_check_same_architecture: run the check_same_architecture function to verify two model configs share the same architecture
run_main: run the main function to execute the default model averaging pipeline with hardcoded experiment config
